summary: Frontend-only E2E testing (Playwright, public preview URL) of the pt-BR 'Prime Excelência' reseller CRM SPA (localStorage-mocked data, no backend calls). Covered: fake login/logout + ProtectedRoute, Dashboard KPIs/period filters/charts/recent list, full 5-step Nova Matrícula wizard (validation toasts, CPF/phone/CEP masks, EJA dynamic extra fields, document checklist, commercial step, review, creation of sequential number 000013), Enrollment detail (status change + persistence, editable checklist + persistence, client-safe WhatsApp summary, clipboard copy, print, disabled PDF), Matrículas list (13 rows, search by number/name/cpf/phone/course, all 5 selects, 5 period presets), Alunos list/detail tabs/notes, Cursos sheet edit+save+persistence, Campanhas aggregation, Relatórios KPIs+5 charts, invalid-id/unknown-route handling, and 390px mobile drawer + overflow checks. 2 real functional bugs found (1 data-loss), plus minor UI/design nits. No console/page errors anywhere. Backend intentionally not tested (not used by this phase).

ui_bugs.issue: On /matriculas/nova BOTH 'Nova Matrícula' and 'Matrículas' render as active (bg-indigo-600). The '/matriculas' NavLink needs the `end` prop (or an explicit isActive check) so parent route does not match child paths.

Saved notes are NOT shown after a hard reload / direct URL access. Value persists in localStorage ('TEST nota persistencia' confirmed) but textarea renders empty because `useState(student?.notes)` is initialised on the first render while DataContext is still loading (student undefined) and never re-syncs. Works only on client-side navigation. User perceives data loss and a subsequent save would wipe the note.

integration_issues.flow: Nova Matrícula -> existing student reused by CPF (enrollmentService.createEnrollment)
integration_issues.issue: DATA LOSS: `Object.assign(student, payload.student)` overwrites the existing student record with the (mostly empty) wizard fields. Reproduced: created an enrollment for CPF 123.456.789-01 (Juliana Ferreira Alves) filling only name/CPF/phone -> stored student lost email, birthDate, address, number, neighborhood, city, state, zip (all became ''). Detail page then shows 'E-mail:' blank and '-' for city/state. Fix: merge only non-empty incoming values (or keep existing values as fallback).

design_issues.screen: Relatórios / Dashboard - 'Matrículas por curso' & 'Cursos mais vendidos' charts
issues: Rotated X-axis course labels are clipped at the left/bottom edge of the card ('...de Produtos Perigosos' truncated) - increase chart bottom margin or truncate labels
Dashboard 'Cursos mais vendidos' vertical BarChart Y-axis labels (width 160) wrap into 3 lines and visually collide with each other
Step labels 'Documentos' and 'Comercial' touch with no horizontal gap (WizardStepper), slightly cramped on mobile
Error toasts observed still on screen ~15s+ after being triggered while other interactions happened (stacked toasts persist longer than expected); consider explicit duration

action_items: FIX (data loss): enrollmentService.createEnrollment - do not blindly Object.assign wizard student payload over an existing student found by CPF; merge only truthy/non-empty fields.
FIX: StudentDetail notes textarea must sync with student.notes (useEffect on student, or render a loading state until DataContext finishes loading) so notes appear after reload/direct URL.
FIX (minor): add `end` to the '/matriculas' sidebar NavLink so it isn't active on /matriculas/nova.
POLISH: chart label clipping in Relatórios/Dashboard bar charts; wizard stepper label spacing on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: enrollmentService.createEnrollment generates the enrollment number with `String(enrollments.length + 1)` - any future delete (or two tabs writing concurrently) will produce duplicate numbers. Derive from max(existing number)+1.

StudentDetail/EnrollmentDetail render 'não encontrado' while DataContext.loading is still true, so a direct URL load flashes the not-found state before data hydrates; gate on `loading` like Dashboard does.

Object mutation in services (`Object.assign(student, ...)`, `courses[idx] = {...}` on the array returned by readCollection) mutates shared state read from storage; prefer immutable updates for predictability.
Wizard state is kept only in NewEnrollment component state - a page refresh mid-wizard silently discards everything; consider draft persistence (localStorage) for a multi-step flow.
Step2 marks fullName/cpf/phone as required only via toast; the labels have no required indicator and there is no CPF format/length validation (accepted '111.222.333-44' partial input paths).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (2 functional bugs out of ~45 verified checks; all navigation, wizard, filters, persistence-of-status/documents/courses, summary privacy, clipboard, print, mobile drawer passed)

seed_data_creation: No server-side seed. Created (per-browser localStorage only) test enrollments Nº 000013/000014 and students 'TEST Aluno QA Playwright', 'TEST Novo Aluno Lista', campaign 'TEST Campanha Nova QA'. These live only in the throwaway Playwright browser profiles - the real user's localStorage is untouched.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty (template only). Not required: login is fake and accepts any email/password (used teste@teste.com / 123456).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a pure frontend SPA at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (no /api calls). Each Playwright run gets a fresh browser profile, so localStorage re-seeds -> enrollments always start at 12 and a newly created one is always Nº 000013 within the same run only. Verified working: login/logout/ProtectedRoute, all 7 sidebar routes, dashboard period filters + charts + recent links, wizard steps 1-5 with all validation toasts, masks (CPF/phone/CEP), EJA extra fields (crs-6 only), doc checklist badge, enrollment detail status/doc persistence, summary tab leaks nothing (no margem/campanha/observações), copy-to-WhatsApp clipboard text, print, disabled PDF, list search+5 filters+5 period presets, students list/tabs, course sheet edit+persist, campaigns aggregation, reports charts, invalid ids, mobile 390px drawer with no horizontal overflow. Re-test after fixes: (1) existing-student-by-CPF must keep its previous email/address fields, (2) student notes visible after hard reload, (3) sidebar active state on /matriculas/nova.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (student data loss): createEnrollment locates an existing student by CPF then does `Object.assign(student, payload.student)`; the wizard payload always contains every student key (empty strings for untouched optional fields), so empty values overwrite persisted data. Bug 2 (notes not shown): StudentDetail initialises `notes` with `useState(student?.notes || '')`; on a hard reload DataContext.students is still [] on first render, so the initial value is '' and there is no effect re-syncing it when the student arrives.
